reviews.review: Needs more environmental content and guns/gadgets etc. To be worth its asking price.

Out of the literal hundreds of games I've played on PC and consoles throughout my life, this is one of my absolute favorites. At least top 20. Early Access, but could release today and be more feature complete than most projects ever get.

The customization is decent, but rapidly expanding. I expect by the end of development it will be monstrous. Aesthetic customization is already shockingly expansive. The classes all stand well on their own, but also benefit each other in very puzzle-piece like ways, which keeps solo play from being a pain, while also making co-op shine -a hard balance to strike.

The enemy variety is really nice, although if I'm being honest I would love for them to pour even more resources into adding more, just because of how much it adds to the experience.

There's an endgame being built right now, which is an interesting concept for a game that plays like L4D in a high poly minecraft version of Starship Troopers, but it honestly makes a lot of sense. I'm definitely looking forward to raidlike endgame. Who knows, maybe they'll add raid-style bosses too.

If you like L4D, co-op, or the game looks even mildly interesting -buy it. Don't hesitate, buy it. I can't imagine regretting this  purchase if you're at all interested in it after watching the trailer.

I usually do not do early access stuff cause it's often half-done, but this game has a lot to offer.

How I played: Tried all classes, prestiged 2 classes out of 4. Tried all the weapons. Did all the bioms on every difficulty. I did not test the new mechanic forge with making weapons extra-powerful and that whole thing.

Good stuff:
Gameplay is great, the mining mechanic with keeping the materials and golds are nice, waves of all sorts of different bugs are really nice as well, I like the vararity in the enemies.
The maps are cool, depending on the biom there will have different enviromental storms or the enviroment will affect movement (Ex: ice slide) tempature is a big thing as well.
Every class is useful in someway and you can build the classes in different ways depending on the upgrades, weapons, type of gadgets, etc.
Mission modifiers are great, adding challenge and extra rewards (Ex: no shield, low gravity, extra explody-guy, etc.)
there's so much more to love, but I won't spoil everything.
Performance is fine, optimization is good
Community is great I talked to a lot of different people in game and in the discord community.

Bad stuff:
Had a lot of different bugs, it's early access and a bunch have been fix so this one is more of an inconveniance than bad.
I find the missions a bit lacking and not very intriguing to do, it's usually just follow a set of levels to do, nothing special per say.
Playing a mission alone is a bit boring and can get real hard (it's defenitely meant to be played as a co-op game)

Conclusion:
Great game, it's a definit buy! I really like this game and it's great to play alone (with other strangers) and with friends. their might be a bit of a steep learning curve, but it's very manageable, it's not unforgiving.
